# Incident Report: Poor Accessibility on S-SFX-004

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-SFX-01`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence from change logs, timing alignment with KPI degradation, and specific minor alarms on affected child nodes. Maintenance calendar and external events were not checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-28 01:30 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-28 01:36
- **Affected:** S-SFX-004, S-SFX-007

## Summary

A configuration push template (RT-2.4) was applied to AGG-SFX-01, causing RRC failures across sites under its control including S-SFX-004.

Poor accessibility and RRC failure rate increase on S-SFX-004 and other sites under AGG-SFX-01 since 2026-09-28 01:30 and ongoing at 2026-09-28 08:20.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-28 01:30: Anomaly onset: S-SFX-004 rrc_success_pct drop and drop_rate_pct spike. [ANM-000409, ANM-000410, T1, T5]
- 2026-09-28 01:36: Configuration push CHG-2026-0071 executed on AGG-SFX-01. [CHG-2026-0071, T4]
- 2026-09-28 01:54: Minor alarm ALM-000616 raised on S-SFX-004 for high RRC failure rate. [ALM-000616, T3, T8]
- 2026-09-28 01:57: Minor alarm ALM-000617 raised on S-SFX-007 for high RRC failure rate. [ALM-000617, T8]

## Evidence

- S-SFX-004 experienced an ongoing anomaly in rrc_success_pct and drop_rate_pct starting at 2026-09-28 01:30. [T1, T5, ANM-000409, ANM-000410]
- Configuration change CHG-2026-0071 was applied to aggregation router AGG-SFX-01 at 2026-09-28 01:36. [T4, CHG-2026-0071]
- Minor RRC failure rate alarms were raised on S-SFX-004 and S-SFX-007 following the aggregation router change. [T3, T8, ALM-000616, ALM-000617]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-SFX-01: confirmed. Change CHG-2026-0071 on common ancestor AGG-SFX-01 coincides precisely with the timing and shape of the RRC failures across child sites including S-SFX-004. [CHG-2026-0071, T4, RB-CHANGE-CORRELATION#03, RB-BAD-CHANGE#05]
2. **capacity** at S-SFX-004: rejected. No capacity alarms or specific congestion indicators were reported, and anomalies span multiple sites under the common aggregation router. [RB-CONGESTION#05, T3]
3. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SFX-01-B: rejected. No major or critical transport link alarms were observed on LNK-SFX-01-B. [T3, T2]

## Ruled out

- LNK-SFX-01-B: No major or critical alarms found on the fiber link connecting S-SFX-004 to AGG-SFX-01.

## Recommended actions

- Review and roll back configuration change CHG-2026-0071 on AGG-SFX-01 if required.
- Verify RRC success rate recovery on S-SFX-004 and peer sites following any remediation.
